message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'EOF'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7068,"var":"ctxt","code":"xmlParseReference(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt)","note":"The parser reaches an attacker-controlled entity reference in document content."},
  {"step":2,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7398,"var":"cur","code":"cur = ent->children;","note":"The cached entity subtree is taken from the entity declaration for reuse."},
  {"step":3,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7399,"var":"ent->children","code":"ent->children = NULL;","note":"The entity loses ownership of the cached subtree, so later operations work on detached nodes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7403,"var":"cur->parent","code":"cur->parent = NULL;","note":"The detached node is unlinked from its original parent, leaving namespace resolution dependent on stale source-tree state."},
  {"step":5,"file":"parser.c","function":"xmlParseReference","line":7404,"var":"nw","code":"nw = xmlDocCopyNode(cur, ctxt->myDoc, 1);","note":"The detached node is copied into the parser document, which invokes xmlStaticCopyNode and its namespace lookup logic."},
  {"step":6,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4282,"var":"node->ns->prefix","code":"ns = xmlSearchNs(node->doc, node, node->ns->prefix);","note":"The copy path uses the source node's namespace prefix to search the original tree when the namespace is not in scope in the destination tree."},
  {"step":7,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4287,"var":"ns->href","code":"ret->ns = xmlNewNs(root, ns->href, ns->prefix);","note":"If the namespace is only found in the original tree, the code dereferences the source namespace object and copies its href/prefix into the new tree."},
  {"step":8,"file":"tree.c","function":"xmlStaticCopyNode","line":4289,"var":"node->ns","code":"ret->ns = xmlNewReconciledNs(doc, ret, node->ns);","note":"Fallback reconciliation still consumes the source node's namespace pointer, so a stale or freed namespace object can be read during copy."}
]
EOF
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.xml /workspace/candidate_trace.json
